metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Remains limited Thursday
metadata.description: Thomas (shoulder) was a limited participant at the Raiders' practice Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Thomas has logged back-to-back limited practices to open the week as a result of a shoulder injury he suffered in Week 7 versus the Rams. The tight end will have one more chance to log a full practice before Sunday's matchup with the Jets.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Limited to open Week 8 prep
metadata.description: Thomas (shoulder) was a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, Anthony Galaviz of The Fresno Bee reports.
metadata.analysis: Thomas picked up a shoulder injury against the Rams in Week 7, although he was cleared to return to the contest and finished with one catch on as many targets for eight yards. He would avoid an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Jets if he were to practice in full over the next two days.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas (shoulder) limited in practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Ian Thomas was limited in practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Thomas remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas catches pass in Week 7
metadata.description: Ian Thomas caught his only target for eight yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7.
metadata.analysis: Thomas has been more of an afterthought in the offense to this point, finishing with two or more targets in each of the first seven contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Back in action
metadata.description: Thomas (shoulder) has returned to Sunday's contest against the Rams, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.
metadata.analysis: Thomas is back in action after briefly being sidelined with a shoulder injury that he suffered early in the game. He'll continue to operate as a depth option at tight end behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer versus Los Angeles.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Dealing with shoulder injury
metadata.description: Thomas (shoulder) is questionable to return to Sunday's contest against the Rams.
metadata.analysis: Thomas suffered a shoulder injury early in the first half, and his status for the rest of the game is now uncertain. In his absence, Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer will continue to operate as the Raiders' primary options at tight end.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas finds the end zone in Week 4
metadata.description: Ian Thomas caught both of his targets for 32 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
metadata.analysis: Thomas found the end zone on a 27-yard pass from Kirk Cousins in the first quarter. The veteran will continue to be the third tight end behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer, which will limit his upside in fantasy leagues. He will face the Patriots in Week 5.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Secures TD in loss to Kansas City
metadata.description: Thomas caught both of his targets for 32 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Chiefs.
metadata.analysis: Thomas logged just 26 of 84 offensive snaps, playing well behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer at tight end, but the veteran Thomas has carved out a prominent blocking role under coach Klint Kubiak. Thomas has three grabs for 43 yards and the score across four games this season and isn't relevant in fantasy.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Sees offensive snaps in win
metadata.description: Thomas played 31 offensive snaps in Sunday's 27-13 win over the Dolphins.
metadata.analysis: Thomas played 45 percent of the Raiders' offensive snaps during Week 1, helping Ashton Jeanty get to 102 rushing yards. The No. 3 tight end was frequently in the trenches, assisting the team's revamped offensive line as it pushed to be 1-0 in 2026.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas re-signs with Raiders
metadata.description: The Raiders re-signed TE Ian Thomas to a one-year contract.
metadata.analysis: Thomas hauled in 13 passes with Las Vegas last season. He will remain in a depth role.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Re-ups with Raiders
metadata.description: Las Vegas re-signed Thomas to a one-year contract Tuesday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: Thomas will run it back with the Raiders after having secured all 13 of his targets for 114 yards across 15 regular-season appearances with the team in 2025. He projects for a blocking role behind Brock Bowers (knee) and Michael Mayer again next season.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Catches all 13 targets in 2025
metadata.description: Thomas finished the 2025 season with 13 receptions for 114 yards on 13 targets over 15 games.
metadata.analysis: After spending seven seasons in Carolina, Thomas produced a first down on five of his 13 catches with the Raiders while providing depth and blocking reps behind fellow tight ends Brock Bowers (knee) and Michael Mayer. Thomas, who turns 30 years old in June, will be an unrestricted free agent again this offseason.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Overcomes calf issue
metadata.description: Thomas (calf) logged a full practice Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Thomas was sidelined for the Raiders' Week 15 game against the Eagles. After logging a full session, he should be ready to return Sunday against the Texans. While Thomas has logged around a 50 percent offensive snap rate in his last few healthy games, he has not reached 40 receiving yards in a game this season and has surpassed 20 yards only once.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Not playing vs. Philadelphia
metadata.description: Thomas (calf) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: Thomas suffered a calf injury during the Raiders' Week 14 loss to the Broncos. He was tagged as questionable for Week 15 after logging a full practice Friday, but he will be sidelined for Sunday's game after going through pregame warmups. With Thomas not playing, Carter Runyon will step up as the Raiders' TE3 behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Questionable to play Sunday
metadata.description: Thomas (calf) is questionable for Sunday's matchup against the Eagles.
metadata.analysis: Thomas continued to trend in a positive direction with full participation in practice Friday after opening the week as a non-participant with a calf injury sustained in Week 14. The 29-year-old's progression is a good sign for his availability Sunday against the Eagles. If Thomas is unable to play, Carter Runyon will act as the No. 3 tight end behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Limited with calf
metadata.description: Thomas (calf) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Thomas' upgrade to limited participation Thursday is a good sign for his chances of suiting up for Sunday's game against the Eagles. After exiting the second half of last week's loss to the Broncos, the tight end has one more opportunity to log a full practice and avoid an injury designation for Sunday's contest. If the 29-year-old is unable to play, Carter Runyon will take over as the No. 3 tight end behind Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Doesn't practice Wednesday
metadata.analysis: Thomas suffered a calf injury during the second half of this past Sunday's loss to the Broncos and did not return. His practice participation over the next two days will shed light on his status heading into this Sunday's game against the Eagles.

metadata.title: Ian Thomas - Won't return vs. Broncos
metadata.description: Thomas (calf) has been ruled out for the remainder of Sunday's matchup versus Denver.
metadata.analysis: Thomas is done for the day after exiting the game in the second half. With Michael Mayer out with an ankle injury, Brock Bowers and Carter Runyon are now the only healthy tight ends available for the Raiders.
